steps.action: Station Master issues Authority Form T/369(3b) or T/A 912 to Loco Pilot.
Verify clear route and crank locking on affected point.
Speed restricted to 15 km/h over affected turnouts / 25 km/h in block.
Log failure in Signal Failure Register and alert S&T ESR team.
TPC (Traction Power Controller) isolates faulty sector and applies emergency dead block.
Coasting order issued to following electric trains.
Dispatch Tower Wagon / OHE breakdown crew from nearest depot.
Grant Power Block and Permit-to-Work (PTW) for repair.

title: Manned / Interlocked Level Crossing Gate Failure
trigger_conditions: Gate boom broken by road vehicle

steps.action: Gateman displays Red hand signal / Banner flag towards approaching trains.
Secure gate with emergency chains and padlocks.
Issue Caution Order (Stop & Proceed at 10 km/h whistling continuously).
Inform RPF and local police for road traffic control.
Flash Red emergency flasher light on Loco immediately.
Protect track on both ends with detonators (at 600m and 1200m).
Order Accident Relief Train (ART) and Medical Relief Van (ARMV).
Impose immediate traffic block on both Up and Down lines.
